Chapter 1279: 29: Light

Chapter 1279: Chapter 29: Light

“Although the Lord of Heaven Light did not directly cultivate the Eternal Lord, all current Eternal Lords bear the karmic legacy of the Lord of Heaven Light, having sublimated to the utmost on the cultivation system established by him.”

The golden figure spoke with admiration, highly praising the Lord of Heaven Light.

“I see.” Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

Each Eternal Lord walks a different path, pursues different things.

The Lord of Heaven Light laid the foundational roots for cultivation in this realm, which led to the emergence of the Eternal Lords.

“The Lord of Heaven Light once created an inheritance specifically for how the weak can become an Eternal Lord, composed of thirty-three original texts, of which the great Master of Wushan obtained one such original text.”

The golden figure said.

The so-called original inheritance is hand-written by the creator of the inheritance. Although it can be copied, the flavor is diminished; its impact on cultivators is most direct and authentic when it is the original inheritance.

“This is the inheritance.”

The golden figure flipped his right hand, revealing a book before them.

“An inheritance created specifically for breaking through to the Thirteenth Tier?”

Lin Yuan felt quite excited within; so far, any Thirteenth Tier inheritance he had acquired was for the enhancement of his foundational strength.

But specifically for breaking through to the Thirteenth Tier? He had found none.

Lin Yuan had very limited understanding of how to break through to the Thirteenth Tier and overcome the time cycle.

He knew only that spreading his evolution path and allowing more beings to cultivate would form ‘anchor points’, ‘beacons’ for himself trapped in the time cycle.

Moreover, facing the time cycle when breaking through to the Thirteenth Tier would be a test he had never encountered before; if one fails the first time, related memories would be erased, and then one would start the identical cycle anew.

This is why it is termed ‘time cycle’.

…

Lin Yuan immediately picked up the book in front of him.

The book was very thin, displaying a hue of green jade.

“This original inheritance can only be comprehended here, don’t take it out.” The golden figure immediately stated.

There is only this one original inheritance; if Lin Yuan takes it away without returning it, it would mean future cultivators who pass the test would lose the chance to comprehend this inheritance.

“Of course.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

It was simply a matter of leaving an avatar here for a long term.

It’s not a difficult task.

“The Lord of Heaven Light’s understanding of breaking through the Thirteenth Tier…”

Lin Yuan appeared expectant and immediately began to open the book.

As the green jade-colored book was opened, countless messages surged forth, entering Lin Yuan’s mind.

Countless messages condensed into a towering figure.

He stood beneath the vast firmament, his whole body emitting infinite light, illuminating everywhere; this illumination was markedly different from that of Fierce Sun.

The illumination of the Ancestor of Fierce Sun, the first source world, was a mighty erosion, with its daylight creating dominion.

Whereas this infinite illumination now was inclusive, embracing everything, it had no sense of erosion or oppression.

Lin Yuan observed the towering figure beneath the firmament, only feeling incomparably ‘warm and comfortable’.

“Is this the Lord of Heaven Light?” Lin Yuan immediately understood that this towering figure endowed with infinite light was indeed the Lord of Heaven Light.

To be precise, it was an imprint left by the Lord of Heaven Light, intended to bear the inheritance.

“So powerful.” Lin Yuan thought inwardly.

Even though the towering figure exerted no pressure on him, Lin Yuan instinctively felt that the Ancestor of Fierce Sun was inferior to the Lord of Heaven Light.

Even the other five ancestors of the first source world were all inferior to the Lord of Heaven Light.

The Lord of Heaven Light was so powerful that he no longer needed to use feelings of pressure, but touched a higher realm.

“How to become an Eternal Lord, how to transform into a time life…” The Lord of Heaven Light said with a smile, “The main thing is how to break through the time cycle.”

“Time cycle is the greatest threshold for all lives in endless dimensional dimensions to transform into time lives.”

“Lives caught in the time cycle will face testing they have not previously encountered; past methods and abilities will become ineffective.”

“Thus, to break through the time cycle, there are often two choices.”

The Lord of Heaven Light said with a gentle smile: “First is to do nothing, since the test of the time cycle is something you’ve never encountered, it is meaningless to prepare regardless.”

“Second is to prepare to the utmost, as the infinite great way is also finite; if you can prepare all tests, reaching ‘omniscience and omnipotence’, you can naturally easily break through the time cycle.”

The Lord of Heaven Light spoke in a warm tone.

Lin Yuan listened seriously.

The information given by the Lord of Heaven Light was largely known to Lin Yuan, likely just an introduction to breaking through the time cycle.

“Next, I will explain how I break through the time cycle in my way.”

The Lord of Heaven Light said with a smile: “Firstly, what do you think runes are?”

“What are runes?” Lin Yuan fell into contemplation.

Runes, as he encountered them, were a means, a secret technique.

Having nearly ‘universal’ use.

They can maintain the existence of particle worlds.

They can enhance the power of lethal moves.

And so on.

“To you, runes should only be a kind of means; if one specializes in runes within the time cycle, they certainly cannot use runes.” The Lord of Heaven Light said.

“Yes.” Lin Yuan nodded.

He had long prepared to lose all means and abilities within the time cycle.

Runes?

Inner universe?

Physical body?

The more Lin Yuan excelled in these, the less he could wield them once caught in the time cycle.

“But to me, runes are not just a means, they are the foundation of all things, even time, which can be recreated with runes, so even in a time cycle, runes can be used.”

The Lord of Heaven Light continued.

“Runes can be used within the time cycle?” Lin Yuan’s pupils slightly contracted.

“With what means do you condense runes? Spiritual power? Soul power? Blood power? Or other diverse forces?” The Lord of Heaven Light asked.

Lin Yuan listened carefully.

He condensed runes using the power of his inner universe.

This was also one of the primary means Lin Yuan mastered.

“Indeed, the time cycle will bypass sealing all means you specialize in; for instance, if you specialize in condensing runes with spiritual power, then during the time cycle, you won’t be able to use any spiritual power.”

“You excel at condensing runes with soul power, the soul power will be closed off, same with blood power.”

The Lord of Heaven Light gently looked at Lin Yuan, “But the runes themselves will not disappear.”

“It only creates the illusion that the runes are gone due to the incapability of utilizing the means to activate runes.”

…

Lin Yuan was absorbed in the recounting from the Lord of Heaven Light within the book, whose understanding of runes far exceeded Lin Yuan’s imagination; no wonder ‘Li Hong’ believed among the Eternal Lords, the Lord of Heaven Light was indisputably the strongest.

Now, Lin Yuan shared the same thought as ‘Li Hong’.

“This is truly the essence of runes.” Lin Yuan’s eyes were full of awe.

The inheritance recorded in the book brought Lin Yuan no direct enhancement to power.

It was far inferior to the yield of creating a particle world.

Yet Lin Yuan felt his comprehension of runes had greatly ascended.

To put it plainly.

Originally, runes for Lin Yuan were a keen treasure sword.

But now, runes to Lin Yuan were not just a sword.

Shield? Longblade? Giant mace?

Lin Yuan could effortlessly possess any weapon.

“If runes can truly be used within the time cycle, then the likelihood of breaking through the cycle would be a lot higher.” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

In a time cycle where rules are constrained, being able to wield rune force is akin to having a cheat.

…

Chaos Void.

“Runes.”

Lin Yuan immediately felt his understanding of runes had transformed, no longer limited to a kind of means, but encapsulating all things.

“Gather.”

With a slight thought, Lin Yuan gathered rune after rune, forming an avatar.

This avatar’s aura was terrifying, permeating layers of time and space; it almost had the strength akin to the Abyss Dragon.

And this was just Lin Yuan’s external application of runes, with an unfathomable enhancement to his own power.
